relationships.subject: IL-23/IL-17A/TRPV1 signaling axis
relationships.evidence_quote: Mechanistically, the pain sensitivity of female mice is mainly dependent on the IL-23/IL-17A/TRPV1 signaling axis, bidirectionally regulated by estrogen and its receptor α (ER-α).

key_findings: Female CIPN pain depends on the IL-23/IL-17A/TRPV1 axis regulated by estrogen and ER-α, whereas male mice are driven by TLR9-mediated macrophage activation and TNF/CXCL1 release.
Duloxetine and other analgesics show sex-dependent efficacy in CIPN.
